payload.summary: Set up privacy@psychiatry.tools forwarding, then switch the privacy page contact back to it
payload.detail: psychiatry.tools DNS is at name.com and has no MX records, so privacy@psychiatry.tools bounces. The owner chose (27 Oct, decision card) to show Josh@psychexplained.com until then. Owner step: name.com, psychiatry.tools, Email Forwarding, forward privacy@ to Josh@psychexplained.com, then send a test. Agent step after that: change PRIVACY_CONTACT_EMAIL in src/lib/privacy-page-content.tsx and the mailto pin in tests/privacy-ui.test.ts. Note josh@stoicable.com is not usable: its name servers refuse queries.
